title: The Long Machine
author: B. M. Dunmore
blurb: Astrid Kavanagh, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
